q: The group of eleven players from Tashkent won the football tournament today.
why: «Group of eleven players» jamoani bildiradi.

wrong.match: «Match» — o'yin ma'nosini bildiradi, lekin bu yerda o'yinchilar guruhi nazarda tutilgan.
wrong.watch: «Watch» — soat yoki tomosha qilish, bu kontekstga mos emas.

q: We have a big football ______ against Samarkand tomorrow.
why: «Football ______» sport musobaqasini, yani match so'zini talab qiladi.

wrong.team: «Team» — jamoa, gapda jamoaga qarshi o'yin haqida boryapti.
wrong.lose: «Lose» — yutqazmoq fe'li bu yerga grammatik jihatdan mos tushmaydi.

q: Aziz looks at the time on his wrist before running to his English lesson.
why: «Wrist» bilak va vaqtni ko'rish «watch» (qo'l soati) bilan bog'liq.

q: Do not play carelessly, otherwise we will ______ the game.
why: «Play carelessly» va o'yinda mag'lub bo'lish «lose» so'zini talab qiladi.

wrong.watch: «Watch» — kuzatmoq, bu yerda o'yinni boy bermaslik haqida gap ketmoqda.

q: If you study hard, you will certainly ______ the math test.
why: «Study hard» va testdan muvaffaqiyatli o'tish «pass» so'zini talab qiladi.

q: The teacher wrote numbers five and four in my notebook for my good answers.
why: «Numbers five and four in my notebook» baholarni («marks») bildiradi.

q: We must carry our heavy ______ to the check-in desk at Tashkent Airport.
why: «Check-in desk» va aeroportda og'ir yuklarni ko'tarish «luggage» (bagaj) so'ziga mos keladi.

wrong.plane: «Plane» — samolyot, uni check-in deskda ko'tarib bo'lmaydi.

q: The big flying machine with wings took off into the blue sky towards Dubai.
why: «Big flying machine with wings» samolyotni («plane») tavsiflaydi.

q: Hurry up! The bus is leaving and we will be ______ for school.
why: «Hurry up» va avtobusdan qolish ehtimoli «late» (kechikish) so'zini talab qiladi.

q: Jasur spent all evening doing his history and physics exercises at home.
why: «History and physics exercises at home» bu uy vazifasi va maktab ishidir («school work»).

q: This physics problem is too ______; I cannot solve it.
why: «Cannot solve it» so'zi masala juda qiyin («difficult») ekanini bildiradi.

wrong.school work: «School work» — maktab ishi, sifat o'rniga mos kelmaydi.
wrong.boring: «Boring» — zerikarli, lekin uni yechib bo'lmasligi qiyinligidandir.

q: The documentary had no interesting facts and made everyone fall asleep.
why: «Made everyone fall asleep» kino zerikarli («boring») bo'lganini ko'rsatadi.

q: Dilshod felt very ______ before giving his presentation in front of the whole class.
why: «Before giving his presentation» paytida odam xavotir va tashvishga tushadi («anxious»).

wrong.ashamed: «Ashamed» — xatodan keyingi uyalish, taqdimot oldidan asabiylashish «anxious» bo'ladi.

q: Malika felt terrible after she dropped the birthday cake on the floor in front of guests.
why: Mehmonlar oldida uyatli ish qilish «ashamed» (uyalgan) his qilishga olib keladi.

q: There was nothing to do on the long train ride, so the children were ______.
why: «Nothing to do» sababli bolalar zerikkan («bored») edilar.

q: Temur did not understand the map and went completely the wrong way.
why: «Did not understand the map» odamning boshi qotganini («confused») bildiradi.

q: Mother was ______ because I broke her favorite tea cup.
why: «Broke her favorite tea cup» onaning jahlini chiqaradi («cross»).

wrong.disappointed: «Disappointed» — hafsalasi pir bo'lgan, lekin «cross» jahli chiqqan ma'nosiga yaqinroq.

q: Zarina smiled broadly when she received a brand new smartphone for her birthday.
why: «Smiled broadly» va yangi telefon olish juda xursand («delighted») qiladi.

q: We were ______ with the movie because it was completely different from the book.
why: Kitobdan farq qilgan kino hafsalani pir qiladi («disappointed»).

q: Sardor's face turned red when he called his teacher «Mum» by mistake.
why: O'qituvchiga «Oyi» deb yuborish odamni xijolatga («embarrassed») qo'yadi.
